extractor.prompt: Extract founding relations in Husserl's Ideas I Parts 3-4, focusing on how higher emotional and volitional acts are founded on sensuous presentations, how value-objectities are founded in things, and the stratified constitution of transcendental objects.
extractor.note: Partial extraction covering Chapters 2-4 (§§95-152) on founded noeses and their noematic correlates, the emotional and volitional sphere, and the strata of transcendental constitution. Focuses on: (1) feeling and will acts as founded on presentations; (2) value-objects constituted as founded layers on mere things; (3) hierarchical stratification of constitution; (4) value-characteristics as new sense-dimensions. Not covered: detailed treatment of reell and intentional components (§§97-102), full noematic analysis (§§103-115), attention modifications (§§118-123), or the complete regional constitution of all types of objects (§§149-152).

coverage_note: Extracts from sections 95, 96, 116, 117, and 151-152 which contain explicit treatment of founded acts, layered constitution, and the dependence of higher objectivities on lower strata. Focuses on emotional/volitional founding on perception, value-constitution, and transcendental stratification.

units.claim: A valuing act is founded on a presenting act; the valuing-layer is a non-self-sufficient layer that can be added to or removed from the underlying presentation without ceasing to be concretely complete.
units.quote: A valuing is founded on a presenting (one values what one presents); the valuing-layer can be added to or removed from the underlying presentation

units.claim: Emotional and volitional acts possess multiple intentional layers: a founding presentation-layer plus a founded valuing- or willing-layer, where the higher layer is non-self-sufficient.
units.quote: So these acts are multi-layered: a founding presentation-layer plus a founded valuing- or willing-layer

units.claim: The value-objectity includes and implies the mere thing as its substrate, constituting a new objective layer by adding value-character to the thing-substrate.
units.quote: The value-objectity implies its thing; it brings in, as a new objective layer, the Wertheit

units.term: Analysis restricted to lower stratum of presentations
units.claim: Initial phenomenological analysis studies only the lower stratum of experience—the simple sensuous presentations—as the necessary foundation before extending to founded (higher) acts of feeling and willing.
units.quote: So the analyses so far treated only the lower stratum (the simple sensuous presentations). The task now is to extend to the founded (higher) acts (feeling, willing)

units.term: New sense founded in underlying noesis
units.claim: Founded acts constitute a new sense-dimension that is founded in and encloses the sense of the underlying noesis, bringing entirely new value-characters and value-objectities to appearance.
units.quote: there constitutes itself a new sense, which is founded in that of the underlying noesis, at the same time enclosing it

units.term: Value-objectity as founded on mere thing
units.claim: The value-object (the artwork, the beautiful thing) is a new founded objectity constituted by founded valuing acts on top of and dependent upon the mere thing.
units.quote: with it constitute themselves no new determination-pieces of the mere "things," but values of the things, value-characters (Wertheiten), or concrete value-objectities

units.claim: The constitution of a transcendental thing is determined by different stages and strata, each constituting its own partial unity that serves as a necessary middle-member for the full constitution of the thing.
units.quote: Every stage and every stratum in the stage is characterized thereby, that it constitutes an own unity, which on its side is necessary middle-member for the full constitution of the thing

units.term: Intersubjective constitution of the objective thing
units.claim: The intersubjectively-identical thing is a higher-order constitutive unity founded on and constituted through empathy—the experience of other subjects—which unifies the separate perception-manifolds of a plurality of experiencing egos.
units.quote: The intersubjectively-identical thing (the "objective" thing) is a higher-order constitutive unity, constituted through **empathy** (Einfühlung) — the experience of other subjects
